Frames 16-29: voice but no candidate (lips 0 < 0.3): voice-only for 2.8 s (> 1 s), so wide, with an off-camera voice person p3. Frames 30-39: no faces: wide, no-face.

Split: A and B are 1100 px apart (union wider than the 608 px window). Each region: h = round(200 / 0.35) = 571 (max floor(1920*1920 / 2160) = 1706), w = round(571*2160/1920) = 642, centre x = face centre, y = face centre 300 + 200 / 2 = 400 (split regions centre the face; before, the face top sat 12% down: 517).
Split upscale 960 / 571 = 1.68 <= 2. Split and wide keys carry the area's centre (960, 540) and h 1080 for renderers that don't draw layouts.
